rule: Dose selection remains syndrome-specific. Volume is generated only when source_concentration_per_ml is explicitly present.

entries.indication: anaphylaxis
entries.repeat: every 5 min if ABC compromise persists
entries.source: ERC 2025 anaphylaxis: 0.01 mg/kg = 10 micrograms/kg, max 0.5 mg, using adrenaline 1 mg/mL

entries.indication: general pediatric hypoglycemia when IV treatment is required
entries.repeat: recheck glucose after 5-10 min and repeat as needed
entries.source: ERC/RCUK 2025 PLS: 0.2 g/kg = 2 mL/kg of 10% glucose

entries.indication: cardiac arrest caused by severe hyperkalemia
entries.source: ERC 2025 PLS: insulin 0.1 unit/kg, max 10 units, with glucose

entries.indication: cardiac arrest caused by severe hyperkalemia
entries.source: ERC 2025 PLS: 10% glucose 5 mL/kg, max 250 mL, with insulin

entries.indication: severe hypokalemia <2.5 mmol/L with life-threatening symptoms or cardiac arrest
entries.administration: 2 mmol/min for first 10 min, then remainder if required over 5-10 min
entries.source: ERC 2025 PLS severe hypokalemia recommendation

entries.indication: concurrent hypomagnesemia in severe hypokalemia / selected arrhythmia context
entries.source: ERC 2025 PLS: consider magnesium sulfate 30-50 mg/kg IV

entries.indication: severe acute asthma in children >=2 y after inadequate response to initial therapy
entries.source: GINA 2026: 40-50 mg/kg IV, max 2 g over 20-60 min

entries.indication: moderate/severe acute asthma in children
entries.repeat: up to 3 doses, 20-30 min apart with SABA
entries.source: GINA 2026: 250 micrograms nebulized or 4 puffs of 20 micrograms

entries.indication: pediatric emergency intubation induction
entries.source: Malaysia Ministry of Health Paediatric Protocols 5th ed 2025: ketamine 1-2 mg/kg IV

entries.indication: pediatric emergency intubation neuromuscular blockade
entries.source: Malaysia Ministry of Health Paediatric Protocols 5th ed 2025: rocuronium 1-2 mg/kg IV

entries.indication: pediatric emergency intubation neuromuscular blockade when not contraindicated
entries.source: Malaysia Ministry of Health Paediatric Protocols 5th ed 2025: succinylcholine 1-2 mg/kg IV

entries.indication: mild/moderate acute pain or fever; child >1 month
entries.daily_limit: RCH acute-pain reference: >1 month up to 90 mg/kg/day (max 4 g) for severe pain for max 48 h, then 60 mg/kg/day; use a lower product/age-specific ceiling when applicable
entries.source: Royal Children's Hospital Acute Pain Management guideline, updated Oct 2024

entries.indication: mild/moderate acute pain; child >3 months when NSAID appropriate
entries.daily_limit: 30 mg/kg/day, max 2.4 g/day in cited acute-pain reference
entries.source: Royal Children's Hospital Acute Pain Management guideline, updated Oct 2024

entries.indication: acute severe pain without IV access; age >=1 y / weight >=10 kg in cited ED guidance
entries.repeat: reassess; cited NHS/RCH protocols permit repeat dosing with reduced/repeat dose depending protocol
entries.source: NHSGGC pediatric ED pain guideline 2025 + RCH Acute Pain Management 2024: fentanyl 1.5 micrograms/kg; 50 micrograms/mL injection used intranasally

entries.indication: opioid toxicity with respiratory depression
entries.source: RCH Acute Pain Management 2024: naloxone 10 micrograms/kg, max 400 micrograms initially

entries.indication: opioid toxicity with inadequate response to initial naloxone
entries.source: RCH Acute Pain Management 2024: further 100 micrograms/kg, max 2 mg if inadequate response

entries.indication: post-exacerbation reliever after improvement/discharge in child <=5 y with confirmed asthma/wheeze response
entries.frequency: as needed for symptom relief; seek acute care if needed within 4 h of previous dose
entries.source: GINA 2026: prescribe salbutamol by pMDI and spacer, 2 inhalations as needed after discharge in children <=5 y

entries.indication: severe or life-threatening croup
entries.source: Royal Children's Hospital Croup guideline current online: dexamethasone 0.6 mg/kg, max 12 mg

entries.indication: clinical dehydration from gastroenteritis in child under 5 without shock requiring IV resuscitation
entries.frequency: over 4 h, in small frequent amounts; plus maintenance
entries.source: NICE CG84: 50 mL/kg low-osmolarity ORS over 4 h plus maintenance

entries.indication: moderately severe/severe asthma exacerbation, age <2 years
entries.source: GINA 2026: 1-2 mg/kg/day, max 20 mg/day if <2 years, usually 3-5 days

entries.indication: moderately severe/severe asthma exacerbation, age 2-5 years
entries.source: GINA 2026: 1-2 mg/kg/day, max 30 mg/day age 2-5 years, usually 3-5 days

entries.indication: acute asthma exacerbation, age 6-11 years when systemic steroid indicated
entries.source: GINA 2026: 1-2 mg/kg/day, max 40 mg/day age 6-11 years, usually 3-5 days

entries.indication: acute asthma exacerbation when dexamethasone strategy selected
entries.frequency: 1 dose with/without second dose next day depending age/pathway
entries.source: GINA 2026
